page: Amazon Web Services c8g.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, compute-optimized instance built on the 64-bit ARMv9 architecture. The system is driven by AWS Graviton4 Neoverse-V2 processors operating at 2.8 GHz, delivering 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading. Memory provisioning includes 192.0 GB of DDR5 RAM, establishing a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The server includes 40 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates without local NVMe or SSD storage, and contains no hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-core throughput alongside standard single-thread capability. The instance achieves top-tier results in multi-core metrics, including a multi-threaded stress-ng score of 163,903.0 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 26,474.0, while single-core scores rank in the median range. High-throughput data paths are supported by rapid DDR5 memory performance, registering uncached read bandwidth of 481.1 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 201.25 GB/sec. Application tests show top-tier execution across software compilation in Clang (94,826.0), Redis operations reaching 196.18 million SET operations per second, PassMark database operations, and static web serving throughput measuring 102.43 GB/sec.

Architectural tradeoffs center around storage, single-threaded execution, and memory capacity per core. Because the server provides no local block storage, all disk operations rely entirely on external network storage. Furthermore, workloads requiring x86 instruction sets or specialized AVX-512 extensions require cross-architecture validation or recompilation for ARM64. Cost efficiency is favored in dense scale-out computing, where high physical core counts and DDR5 memory channels can be fully saturated.
AWS c8g.metal-24xl fits distributed microservices, web tier deployments, batch compilation pipelines, in-memory caching fleets, and high-concurrency database processing.

Equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory and 40 Gbps network bandwidth, the instance excludes local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on remote network volumes. Performance profiles reflect top-tier multi-threaded processing, evidenced by high Geekbench multi-core and stress-ng results, coupled with strong memory throughput reaching 481.1 GB/sec for uncached reads. AWS c8g.metal-24xl is targeted at high-concurrency environments including large-scale web servers, software build farms, in-memory data caches, and parallelized backend data processing.
